verdict.rationale: Activepieces is open source (MIT-licensed per GitHub and community comments) and provides documented self-hosting install options, including a single-container Docker setup and one-line Docker Compose install script, explicitly for running on your own infrastructure. Community evidence confirms hands-on local setup attempts, corroborating that self-hosting is real and functional, though with some rough edges noted (missing dev setup docs). Missing for 10: no independent long-term production self-hosting report at scale.
